weaknesses.title: COMMONPREFIX of /etc vs /var is slash-only /
weaknesses.detail: Agents treating non-empty LCP as a useful path root get '/' for unrelated trees. No path-segment-aware COMMONPREFIX (dirname-safe). BLANK check cannot reject '/' alone without extra EQS.

weaknesses.title: TRUNCALL silently destroys paths
weaknesses.detail: clip width 12 turns /var/log/deep/... into /var/log/dee. Same silent truncate class as PADALL. No STRICT/refuse mode; TRUNCALL_HIT counts clips but easy to ignore.

weaknesses.title: Single-field COMMONPREFIX returns whole field
weaknesses.detail: One path bag → LCP is the full path, so root action reports success with root=full file path. Agents should special-case LINES==1.

weaknesses.title: Paths need loadlines ||| — WORDS splits on /
weaknesses.detail: WORDS '/var/log/a' may not preserve path depending on tokenizer; multi-token paths need ||| or file READ.
weaknesses.repro: seed WORDS fragile for absolute paths

weaknesses.title: TRUNCALL RIGHT keyword steals RIGHT
weaknesses.detail: Same OFF/DESC/RIGHT class as prior iters.

weaknesses.title: LONGEST ties pick first only
weaknesses.detail: Equal-length paths: first wins; no all-longest bag form.

weaknesses.title: No COMMONPREFIX min-length / dirname boundary option
weaknesses.detail: Want shared root at path segment boundary (last slash). Character LCP can stop mid-segment for similar basenames.

workarounds: EQS root '/' or root len < 2 → treat as no useful root
Inspect TRUNCALL_HIT; prefer clip only for display plates not SoT
If LINES==1 skip root or treat as whole path intentionally
loadlines ||| or READ path list file
